content.description:
Join CAI and play a key role in delivering some of Europe's most complex and innovative mission critical facilities.

We're looking for an Electrical Commissioning Engineer with data centre or mission critical experience to support the testing, validation, and start up of critical electrical infrastructure across major projects throughout Europe.

Working alongside experienced commissioning professionals, you will gain exposure to the full project lifecycle while commissioning systems including MV/LV Switchgear, UPS, ATS, Generators, Substations, Batteries, and associated control systems.

Why Join CAI?

Work on leading hyperscale and colocation data centre projects across Europe

Exposure to cutting edge mission critical technologies

Clear progression opportunities into Lead Commissioning and Project Management roles

Join a global leader in Commissioning, Qualification & Operational Readiness

Collaborative, safety first culture with strong technical mentorship

Opportunity to travel and work across a diverse portfolio of projects

What We're Looking For

2+ years of electrical commissioning experience within data centres or mission critical facilities

Experience testing and commissioning critical electrical systems

Ability to interpret electrical drawings and specifications

Strong communication and technical reporting skills

Willingness to travel across Europe as project requirements dictate

Europe-based role
Extensive travel required
Must be eligible to work within the EU without sponsorship

Whether you're currently a Commissioning Engineer, Electrical Engineer, Commissioning Agent (CxA), or Critical Facilities professional looking to specialise in hyperscale data centres, we'd love to hear from you!
